scope: Independent raw first-episode audit; no universal/statistical/real-robot claim.
limitations: One training seed and two maps are exploratory, not universal or statistically significant.
Direction/posture telemetry is conditional on visited valid states, not matched-state causal evidence.
Secondary 64s diagnostic cannot override a primary 16s failure.
World-Z angular velocity is not Euler yaw derivative under tilt; ideal depth does not establish real-camera or robot safety.
